_comment: Emulator config for `npm run test:rules` ONLY (build order 18).
It exists so the rules suite never shares an emulator with your dev one:
the suite calls clearFirestore() between tests, which would wipe the
workspace you are developing against. Different ports = different process,
so `firebase emulators:start` can stay up while the tests run.
The UI is off and auth is absent because rules-unit-testing mints its own
tokens in-process — no Auth emulator is involved.
